# webhook-inbox

> Rack webhook inbox that captures, inspects and forwards requests with byte-exact bodies and preserved headers, signed with Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 signatures Gem `u955-webhook-inbox`, module `Trysac::WebhookInbox`, MIT licensed, Ruby >= 4.0,
> standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the specs
